description: This file defines a ClassLoader class used for managing autoloading of PHP classes following PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap conventions. It includes methods for adding, setting, and retrieving class loading prefixes, directories, and class maps, and for registering and unregistering the loader with PHP's SPL autoload stack.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Implements a flexible PHP class autoloader supporting multiple standards (PSR-0, PSR-4, classmap).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClassLoader with an optional vendor directory and sets up the include closure.

methods.name: getPrefixes
methods.description: Returns all PSR-0 prefixes currently registered.

methods.name: getPrefixesPsr4
methods.description: Returns all PSR-4 directory prefixes.

methods.name: getFallbackDirs
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-0.

methods.name: getFallbackDirsPsr4
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-4.

methods.name: getClassMap
methods.description: Returns the current class map.

methods.name: addClassMap
methods.description: Merges the provided class map into the existing class map.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers PSR-0 directory prefixes and their associated paths, with an option to prepend.

methods.name: addPsr4
methods.description: Registers PSR-4 namespace prefixes and their directories, with an option to prepend.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces existing PSR-0 prefix paths for a given prefix or fallback if prefix is empty.

methods.name: setPsr4
methods.description: Replaces existing PSR-4 namespace directories for a given prefix or fallback if prefix is empty.

methods.name: setUseIncludePath
methods.description: Enables or disables searching the include path.

methods.name: getUseIncludePath
methods.description: Checks if include path search is enabled.

methods.name: setClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Sets whether the class map should be considered authoritative.

methods.name: isClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Returns whether the class map is authoritative.

methods.name: setApcuPrefix
methods.description: Sets the APCu prefix if APCu caching is enabled.

methods.name: getApcuPrefix
methods.description: Returns the APCu prefix or null if not enabled.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the loader with SPL autoload stack, with optional prepend.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the loader from the SPL autoload stack.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by finding its file and including it.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Finds the file path for a given class using class map, PSR-4, PSR-0, or include paths.

methods.name: getRegisteredLoaders
methods.description: Returns all registered loaders keyed by vendor directory.

methods.name: findFileWithExtension
methods.description: Internal method to locate a class file with a specific extension, supporting PSR-4, PSR-0, and include paths.

methods.name: initializeIncludeClosure
methods.description: Sets up the static include closure used to include class files in an isolated scope.
